answer: I did not submit any job. Garnet has only 20 qubits. I checked this live with a free backend query, and it returned num_qubits = 20. The docs also list garnet as Crystal 20. A 30-qubit GHZ circuit cannot fit on garnet, so the job would fail in transpilation or be rejected, and no counts can be produced. You have three options. You can run a GHZ circuit with up to 20 qubits on garnet. You can run the 30-qubit GHZ on emerald, which has 54 qubits. Or you can test first for free on a :mock alias. No credits were spent.
